mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the capillary sprout was worthwhile because the picture showed it joining another vessel and bringing supplies to the repaired tissue.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to put the new skin cells directly on the wound was frustrating: they could not combine with anything yet, and I did not know the wound needed clearing first.

surprise.text: I expected the newly made skin cells to close the gap immediately, but they stayed at its edge until debris was cleared and they were added to the wound.

arbitrary.text: The need to clear debris before adding the new skin cells was not obvious to me at first, even though clearing the wound made sense once the slots appeared.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing the surface, support and blood supply come together made me curious about how another body process would fit together.
